title: Slinging Shoes
summary: Throw these returning boots for Psychic damage and wear them for +1 Dexterity saves.

fields.Shoe Slinger: Throw as an Action. Base 1 Bludgeoning before modifiers, plus 2d4 Psychic that normally applies even on a miss, but does not apply to Enraged Throw. The boots return and replace current footwear.
fields.Acquisition: Tara on the roof after her earlier visits and the required Long Rest. She takes fish or magical items in trade.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
